    Flock Kitty

    Privacy policy

    Flock Kitty is a browser game. There are no accounts, no sign-in, no ads and no ad tracking. This page says exactly what the game keeps, where, and why. Last updated October 21, 2026.

    What stays in your browser

    The game saves these on your device only, in your browser's local storage. They never leave your device unless noted below, and you can erase them any time by clearing this site's data in your browser.

    • Scores and tags: your best score, the top-10 board on this device, daily-challenge scores and the tag you typed in.
    • Choices: cat, Glock slide, difficulty, sound on or off.
    • Progress: your daily streak and what it unlocked, first-time milestones, and items you bought (with the Stripe receipt id so they can be restored on this device).
    • A random device id: a random code the game makes up the first time it runs. It is not tied to your name, email, phone or anything else about you.

    Gameplay stats (telemetry)

    On the live site the game sends anonymous gameplay events to our server so we can see which waves are too hard, which rides people like and where runs end. Each event carries the random device id above, a random session id, the event itself (for example "wave 5 cleared", "hit at this spot", "bought kicks for $50 of game cash"), your device class (phone, tablet or desktop), operating system family, screen size and language, and the country Cloudflare reports for the connection. We do not store your IP address, name, email, precise location or anything typed into the game. Events are stored in a Cloudflare D1 database. You can switch this off below; the game plays exactly the same.

    Buying things in the shop

    Purchases are handled by Stripe on Stripe's own checkout page. Stripe collects your card details and whatever Stripe asks for; the game never sees them. Stripe's privacy policy applies to that step. After you pay, Stripe tells our server only that the checkout session was paid and which item it was for, and the item is unlocked on the device you bought it on. We keep a record of paid sessions (the Stripe session id, the item, the amount, and the random device id) so purchases can be restored and refunds handled. Everything in the shop is cosmetic.

    Share cards and challenge links

    When you share a run, the image and link contain your score, wave, tag and a link back to the game. Nothing else is included. Who you send them to, and what that app does with them, is up to you and that app.

    Hosting

    The game is served by Cloudflare Pages, which keeps standard, short-lived server logs (such as request time and IP address) to run and protect the service. Those logs are Cloudflare's and are not used by the game.

    Children

    The game is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from them.

    Changes and contact

    If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it. Questions or deletion requests (send your random device id from the title screen's share link if you have it): [contact email]. The game is operated by [your name or company, and where you are based].
